limits: Original finite callers and compressed raw hex outputs are historical reproductions, not additional maintained application programs.

Control serialization only. No image engine, image payload, terminal support, physical layering or performance claim. All i16 values and explicit signed-i32 boundaries are tested, not the entire i32 domain.

Matea already had a persistent exact-byte z=-1 regression; no production code correction was necessary for this issue. The wider archived callers verify finite boundaries without claiming all control options or whole-module parity.
